label: Countable carrier with nonempty event and complement admits every interior event probability
paraphrase: On every countable carrier with measurable singletons, finite or infinite, an event that is nonempty and has a nonempty complement receives each strictly interior probability from some normalized measure giving positive mass to every point. Carrier and partition do not fix the probability; a probability is not thereby shown unavailable.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: A warranted measure on the relevant universe or world carrier that fixes the event probability used in the fine-tuning comparison, then an independently warranted designer inference (unbuilt) and identification of the inferred witness with GOD_4.
